criteria.notes: Reciprocal check requested by the closeout brief, recorded here because it bears on how much this tick is worth. Two consequences, both narrower than they first look. That is a phase-21 defect about gate coverage, not a phase-20 evidence defect, and this record does not attempt to fix it.
